intro: Sites, areas, plants and devices as recorded, plus the IP networks of the devices. The map shows only what is stored; connections from configuration files follow in a later milestone.
listLink: Show the structure as a list
legend: Dashed line: the device's address lies in this network (IPv4 by /24, IPv6 by /64). No other connections are drawn.
